tasks.title: Persist exact question targets and stale states
tasks.goal: Bind clarification questions to captured facts rather than mutable labels.
steps: Define question identity, exact target fact digest, scope, answer state and optional safe secret reference.
Implement deterministic list/validation and unknown/hold states without changing package-authored status.
Expose stale questions when target content or accepted origin changes.
positive_cases: Question survives cosmetic title changes and retains its exact fact target.
negative_cases: Changed target digest or missing origin cannot accept an old answer.
Raw secret values are rejected from persisted question/answer data.
acceptance: Persisted and queried question records identify the same fact capture.
Validation produces typed errors without heuristic semantic verdicts.
tasks.safe_stop: Questions can remain unknown/hold without promoting facts.

tasks.title: Record answers as local refinements transactionally
tasks.goal: Promote explicit accepted answers without rewriting dependency packages.
steps: Prepare answer plus local refinement/decision edits using saved-state preconditions.
Validate target freshness and sensitivity before any write.
Apply with retained before-images and one writer; return exact created facts and partial recovery state.
positive_cases: Accepted answer creates a local addressable refinement and links its question.
negative_cases: Stale question, dirty affected buffer or concurrent local edit refuses.
Package source and unrelated questions remain untouched.
acceptance: Failure injection cannot report complete promotion with missing local fact.
tasks.safe_stop: Keep a reviewable answer plan until saved-state inputs are current.
